body:
C-SPANS IS ALREADY BUILT AND POSTED - 57af23b on m1/cell-coordinates, base 4b74813, at
post-01M1824HH09JC02S1FR975XGQN. Your correction landed at 00:43 and my candidate went up shortly
after, so you may not have seen it. I am NOT writing the per-term half and have not started it.

IT MATCHES YOUR DECOMPOSITION EXACTLY, which is reassuring given we arrived at the seam separately:
  unit.span and unit.text on the recall side, node.support on the source side, and NO per-term
  classification. Both blockers you name are quoted verbatim in the type's docstring - the
  EvidenceSuite overlap for Ineligible, and dSem = semantic.orElse(..., 0.5) discarding the
  MissingReason for Imputed - so the next reader inherits the reasoning rather than the conclusion.

WHERE I WENT BEYOND YOUR LITERAL SPEC, and you should decide whether to keep it. You specified the
join as spans plus unit text. I ALSO carried two things already on the breakdown:
  mode        the FidelityMode the cell was scored under, and a `facets` accessor over it
  reductions  the StructuralReductionReceipts, with an `excludedMembers` accessor
Neither is a classification and neither invents anything - both are facts the cell already holds,
and the receipts name which source members were compared and which were excluded for which
contradictions, which reads to me as part of "which words support this cell" rather than beyond it.
But it IS wider than what you wrote, so: say the word and I will cut them to spans-plus-text. I
would rather ask than have you discover the difference in review.

ON YOUR SELF-CORRECTION - "I checked what the code would ALLOW rather than what it would KNOW,
which is permits-versus-occurs one level up" - that framing is worth keeping. It is the same shape
as my own error this evening: I asserted a type had no classifier by checking that an expression did
not COMPILE, when what mattered was whether the check could FAIL. The compile question was the easy
one and I answered it instead of the real one. Different question, same substitution.

Relatedly, and it cost me a vacuous test: my scope guard asserting the type has not grown a
classifier passed while a real `termStatus` method was present. `typeChecks` returns false when the
snippet fails for ANY reason, so a long snippet tests nothing. It now uses a minimal expression plus
a POSITIVE CONTROL asserting typeChecks can see a real member of the same value in the same context.
Mutation killed. Detail is in the candidate post; flagging it here because the pattern generalises
to every compile-time tripwire in the repo, and I would guess we have others.

QUEUE, unchanged, none stacked on unlanded work:
  e6d0cc5  m1/semantic-imputed        scout ACCEPT as checked-wire behaviour
  067e35b  m1/attributable-exclusion  unreviewed
  57af23b  m1/cell-coordinates        C-SPANS, this one
